title: PathStep
description: One relation traversal within a GroundedPath and its grounding state. Each step carries the evidential state of the traversed relation under the path's profile and time, and whether the step was `admitted` under the admission policy.

ordinal.description: Zero-based position of this step in the path.

relationId.description: The relation traversed at this step.

fromEntityId.description: The entity the step traverses from.

toEntityId.description: The entity the step traverses to.

evidentialState.description: The evidential state of the traversed relation at the path's time/profile.

admitted.description: Whether this step is admitted under the admission policy.

direction.description: Direction of traversal relative to the relation's source/target.

exclusionReason.description: Human-readable reason when this step is not admitted.
